Pizza / Pepperoni Werewolf

7 changes

Changelog

  • CostPlace $450 (was $1,500), Upgr. 1 to 5 $600 / $1,100 / $2,600 / $6,200 / $12,500 (was $1,200 / $2,400 / $4,800 / $9,600 / $19,200), total $23,450 (was $38,700, steeper late game cost scaling)
  • Range42 → 60 (was 40 → 48, stronger late game reach)
  • Damage per hit500 → 22,500 (was 633 → 16,106, shifted into a heavy sniper shot with steeper late game scaling)
  • Attack cooldown2.8 → 1.8 (was 1.8 → 1.6, faster scaling in later upgrades)
  • CleaveReworked into a fast minigun arc with 52 → 2,250 cleave damage on a 0.42 → 0.20 cleave cooldown, 135° angle (was 120°), and 12 → 21 radius (was 12 → 14)
  • Knockback10 → 16 studs (was 5 → 9), with 0.5x knockback against resistant enemies
  • Targeting & knockback rulesLong range sniper attack hits flying enemies and applies all knockback (0.5x against resistant enemies); cleave hits ground enemies only and deals no knockback
